pr_title: Fix unexpected context canceled when migrating repository
pr_comments: You should add a comment that says the default context is needed and the normal context can't be used

issue_context.title: No page redirection is performed at the completion of the migration repository
issue_context.body:
### Description

I have located the problem:  when migration is compend, the `end_time` in the database is not updated.
Maybe  regression of #27089
